records.title: Prescription Behavior Measure -- Drug-to-Indication-to-ICD10 Mapping Design
records.description: Design for mapping provider prescription data to on-label FDA indications with ICD-10 codes, tied to recognized CMS/NQF quality measures. Two implementation paths under evaluation: static reference dataset or LLM-generated mapping with cache.

data_sources.prescriptions: CMS Medicare Part D Public Use Files (data.cms.gov) -- provider NPI + drug + quantity
data_sources.drug_indications: TBD: DailyMed SPL, FDA Orange Book, RxNorm, or LLM-generated mapping
data_sources.icd10: ICD-10-CM code set (icd10_loader.py already in pipeline)
data_sources.quality_measures: NQF quality measures, CMS Quality IDs (e.g., NQF 0018 / CMS 236)

uses.qualityMeasureContext: Adult BP control measure (e.g., NQF 0018 / CMS Quality ID 236 -- Controlling High Blood Pressure)

drugName.description: Brand or generic name of the drug

uses.description: Array of on-label FDA-approved uses, constrained to how they are recognized for this quality measure

indication.description: Clinical description of the on-label indication as applied in this quality measure

qualityMeasureContext.description: Name/identifier of the quality measure this mapping is intended for (e.g., NQF ID, CMS Quality ID)

icd10Codes.description: ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes that qualify as this condition for the quality measure denominator/logic

relevance.description: Does the provider prescribing pattern indicate they treat the patient condition?
relevance.method: Map provider top drugs -> on-label indications -> ICD-10 -> compare to patient condition

integrity.description: Does the prescribing pattern show red flags for fraud or inappropriate prescribing?
integrity.method: Controlled substance ratio vs specialty peers, prescribing outside specialty scope, anomaly detection

path_a.name: Static reference dataset
path_a.source: DailyMed SPL, FDA Orange Book, or RxNorm
path_a.con: Requires finding and licensing the dataset, ETL pipeline to keep current

path_b.name: LLM-generated mapping with cache
path_b.source: GPT or Haiku generates drug-indication-ICD10 mapping on demand
path_b.pro: No dataset dependency, covers any drug immediately
path_b.con: LLM output not verified, hallucination risk on clinical data, per-call cost
path_b.decision: TBD -- acceptable for alpha, close in beta with verified source

records.alpha_gap: Drug-to-indication mapping source not finalized. LLM fallback acceptable for alpha. Close in beta with verified mapping table.
records.patent_relevance: Method of combining CMS prescriber data + ICD-10 + drug indication mapping + quality measure context + LLM synthesis for consumer provider quality signal. Data is public. Method is novel.

records.title: County Economic Enrichment Design
records.description: Enrich provider county attribute with GDP, income, rural/urban classification from public federal data sources.

data_sources.census_acs: api.census.gov ACS 5-year: B19013 (median income), B19025 (mean income). By county FIPS.
data_sources.bea_gdp: apps.bea.gov CAGDP2: county GDP by industry. By county FIPS.
data_sources.usda_rucc: ers.usda.gov Rural-Urban Continuum Codes 2023. CSV, maps FIPS to 1-9 metro/rural scale.

schema.county.gdp_millions: float -- county GDP in millions USD
